import numpy as np


def bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam):
    """Doppler shift (Hz) of the echo off an aircraft at p (m) moving at v (m/s), transmitter tx, receiver rx."""
    p, v, tx, rx = (np.asarray(a, float) for a in (p, v, tx, rx))
    u_rx = (p - rx) / np.linalg.norm(p - rx)      # unit vector receiver -> aircraft
    u_tx = (p - tx) / np.linalg.norm(p - tx)      # unit vector transmitter -> aircraft
    return -(np.dot(v, u_rx) - np.dot(v, u_tx)) / lam

import numpy as np
import pytest

from subject_under_test import bistatic_doppler


def test_bistatic_doppler_collinear_geometry_positive_shift():
    p = (1, 0, 0)
    v = (1, 0, 0)
    tx = (0, 0, 0)
    rx = (2, 0, 0)
    lam = 1.0

    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(2.0)


def test_bistatic_doppler_velocity_perpendicular_gives_zero():
    p = (1, 0, 0)
    v = (0, 1, 0)
    tx = (0, 0, 0)
    rx = (2, 0, 0)
    lam = 1.0

    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(0.0)


def test_bistatic_doppler_diagonal_geometry():
    p = (1, 1, 0)
    v = (1, 0, 0)
    tx = (0, 0, 0)
    rx = (2, 0, 0)
    lam = 2.0

    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(np.sqrt(2) / 2)


def test_bistatic_doppler_swapping_tx_and_rx_flips_sign():
    p = (1, 1, 0)
    v = (1, 0, 0)
    tx = (2, 0, 0)
    rx = (0, 0, 0)
    lam = 2.0

    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(-np.sqrt(2) / 2)


def test_bistatic_doppler_three_dimensional_case():
    p = (0, 0, 2)
    v = (0, 0, 3)
    tx = (0, 0, 0)
    rx = (0, 0, 4)
    lam = 0.5

    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(12.0)


def test_bistatic_doppler_accepts_list_inputs_and_negative_result():
    p = [2, 0, 0]
    v = [-2, 0, 0]
    tx = [0, 0, 0]
    rx = [4, 0, 0]
    lam = 2.0

    assert bistatic_doppler(p, v, tx, rx, lam) == pytest.approx(-2.0)
